WITH project_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.arcref,
    p.fundflux,
    CASE 
      WHEN ss.boxx IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxz IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxz != 0
      THEN ss.boxx / ss.boxz 
      ELSE NULL 
    END AS record_ratio
  FROM scanspatial ss
  INNER JOIN projects p ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
project_avg_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    arcref,
    fundflux,
    AVG(record_ratio) AS project_ratio
  FROM project_ratios
  GROUP BY arcref, fundflux
),
funding_source_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    fundflux,
    AVG(project_ratio) AS funding_avg
  FROM project_avg_ratios
  WHERE project_ratio IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
project_excess AS (
  SELECT 
    par.arcref,
    par.fundflux,
    par.project_ratio,
    par.project_ratio - fsa.funding_avg AS excess
  FROM project_avg_ratios par
  INNER JOIN funding_source_avg fsa ON par.fundflux = fsa.fundflux
  WHERE par.project_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  arcref AS project_id,
  fundflux AS funding_source,
  project_ratio AS ratio,
  excess
FROM project_excess
ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
